mapper.select: SELECT vch.*, gvch.id as group_id, gvch.name as group_name, vce.id AS vce_id, vce.expression AS vce_expression, vce.type AS vce_type, vce.legend AS vce_legend, vp.id as panel_id, vp.name as panel_name, case when vch.var_type=1 then aa.name when vch.var_type=2 then me.name end as var_name FROM visual_chart vch LEFT JOIN visual_chart_element vce ON vch.id = vce.chart_id left join visual_panel vp on vch.panel_id = vp.id left join visual_chart gvch on vch.group_id = gvch.id left join asset_asset aa on vch.var_id = aa.id left join monitor_endpoint me on vch.var_id = me.id WHERE vch.id = #{id}
